A Stage That Came to Them

Grade 9 Theatre · Shark Tank Pitch
THE DIRECTIONS
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.
The idea board
As you record, the four ideas fill in. Find the reason from 1965 behind each one.

THE ACTORTHE AUDIENCE
THE SCENE
Your team wrote a new short play. Tonight in the school theater, you will show the idea to four judges. The best idea wins money for a real show. Your idea board still has four empty boxes. Four people can each help you fill one.
THE HISTORY
Your play comes from theater made by farm workers. In 1965, workers in California stopped work for better pay. Luis Valdez made short plays called actos to help them. Actors played on the back of a truck in the fields.
